topic: Outil SaaS de prise de rendez-vous pour cabinets médicaux
persona: You are a solo developer building a SaaS for Moroccan medical practices: online booking, SMS reminders (to reduce no-shows by 30%), a simple agenda for the secretary. Users: patients, secretaries, doctors. MVP in 3 months, pricing 199 MAD/month per practice. Success: 50 paying practices in 6 months. Risk: doctors reluctant to change habits.
